title: 즉결심판청구 취소절차에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Method of Withdrawing Request for Summary Adjudication)
(1) Withdrawal of a request for summary adjudication under Article 165 (2) of the Road Traffic Act and Article 9 (2) of the Punishment of Minor Offenses Act shall be made by a written withdrawal of request for summary adjudication in Form 1: Provided, That it may be made orally in court. <Amended on January 9, 2009; April 3, 2014>
(2) In the case referred to in the proviso to paragraph (1), a court clerk, junior administrative officer, senior court clerk, or court clerk shall make a record thereof.
